_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is statistically ironclad at 0-for-72 windows with ±2+ moves, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until either a downside trigger (funding negative, F&G <20) or upside breaker (stablecoin growth >60, ETF flows >70) resolves the compression.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil; narrative implies an imminent squeeze but provides no specific forward call, creating an implicit split on timing if not direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding spikes above 0.01% with exchange_netflow dropping below 30 AND fear_greed breaking below 20 would confirm a retest toward Anxiety/Panic leg
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding turns negative with stablecoin_growth breaking above 60 AND etf_flows above 70 would invalidate the coil, confirming Hope/Optimism leg breakout
